cpu_accounting: every arm ran under /usr/bin/time -l; effective cores = (user + sys) / real; thread counts sampled every 20 ms with ps -M on the arm's own pid
cache_state: declared identical per arm: payloads built in-process before the timed phase, fresh Store per arm, no invalidation for one arm only, no cold-cache claim
transport_topology: host-to-host loopback (server and client on this host); the frozen tdx1 selection runs the client in a --cpus=1 container instead, so these rows are not comparable as a container qualification
interference: the host was not idle: desktop processes (WindowServer, Chrome, Codex, WeChat) used CPU throughout and the 1-minute load average was 6.8-7.1 on 14 logical cores; every arm ran under the same declared interference
